ASL Common Signs

On-device no upload

Dynamic signs recognized using a Transformer over 45-frame landmark windows.

HELLORight hand starts near forehead, salutes outward.GOODBYEOpen hand at chest height, fingers wave (curl/uncurl).YESClosed fist, nods up-down twice.NOIndex + middle extended, snap closed twice.PLEASEFlat hand on chest, small circular motion.THANKSFlat hand starts at chin, moves outward.SORRYClosed fist on chest, small circular motion.HELPClosed fist lifts upward (on a flat palm in real ASL).JPinky extended up, trace a J curve downward and hook left.ZIndex extended, trace a Z: right, diagonal down-left, right.MOTHERDominant hand open, thumb touches chin.FATHERDominant hand open, thumb touches forehead.SISTERA-handshape slides from jaw to chin.BROTHERA-handshape slides from forehead to chin.FAMILYF-handshapes circle outward.BABYCradle arms and rock side to side.CHILDPat downward with flat hand.FRIENDHook index fingers together, then reverse.FOODFlat O-hand taps lips twice.WATERW-handshape taps chin twice.MILKSqueeze closed fist twice.BREADSlice across back of non-dominant hand.EATFlat O-hand taps lips.DRINKC-handshape tilts toward mouth.HUNGRYC-handshape slides down chest.COFFEES-handshape grinds on top of other S.TODAYY-hands drop down twice.TOMORROWA-handshape arcs forward from cheek.YESTERDAYA-handshape arcs backward from cheek.MORNINGFlat hand rises from elbow crook.NIGHTBent hand arcs down over wrist.WEEKIndex finger slides across palm.MONTHIndex finger slides down index finger.YEARS-hands circle around each other.REDIndex finger brushes down lips.BLUEB-handshape shakes at shoulder.GREENG-handshape shakes at shoulder.YELLOWY-handshape shakes at shoulder.WHITE5-handshape pulls from chest to O.BLACKIndex finger slides across forehead.ORANGESqueeze C-handshape at chin.PURPLEP-handshape shakes at shoulder.ONEIndex finger points up.TWOIndex and middle fingers point up.THREEThumb, index, middle extend.FOURFour fingers extend, thumb tucked.FIVEAll five fingers extend.TENA-handshape shakes with thumb up.HUNDREDC-handshape after number.THOUSANDBent hand taps palm.HOMEFlat O-hand taps cheek twice.SCHOOLClap hands twice.WORKS-hands tap wrists together.HOSPITALH-handshape draws cross on upper arm.STOREFlat O-hands swing forward twice.CHURCHC-handshape taps back of S-hand.CITYFingertips touch repeatedly while moving.COUNTRYY-handshape circles elbow.GOIndex fingers arc forward.COMEIndex fingers arc toward body.WANTClaw hands pull toward body.NEEDX-handshape bends down twice.LIKE8-handshape pulls from chest.LOVECross arms over chest.KNOWBent hand taps forehead.THINKIndex finger circles at temple.
